div.div: -pe , an enclitic particle with an intensive force Sauscr. -pa, -pi, which is similarly used; cf. -que, as in prope, nempe, quippe; and appearing as p in quispiam, uspiam, etc. (cf. Corss. Ausspr. 2, 846).
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
